assumptions: Full-scale terrain and 23 turbines preserved; this is a parameter-transfer experiment, not the paper wind-tunnel geometry.
Ct=0.95 and annulus/thickness-to-diameter ratios from paper Appendix B.2.
N=2 is a paper default; sigma/D=(0.08/4)/0.4647 is inferred, not explicitly reported for B.2.
TI=0.3% follows cited experiment, not an explicit B.2 inlet condition.
Turbulence length 0.03 m in the reference setup was assumed; scaling by median full-scale diameter is also an assumption.
Air density 1.225 kg/m3 and molecular viscosity 1.5e-5 m2/s are retained assumptions. Reynolds number is not matched after geometric scaling.

Terrain, towers and nacelles remain; paper B.2 omitted tower/nacelle. Domain size, turbine count, transient integration, wall/corner treatment and numerical discretization also differ, not just the mesh.
8 m grid and inferred thin rotor kernel are underresolved; no grid-independent or validated accuracy claim.
5 s force ramp is a numerical startup choice, not a paper parameter.
No multiphase flow, waves, floating motion, flexible moorings, blade-resolved rotation or electrical power model.
